qualification.details: Senior Project Associate: Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology in Mechanical / Agricultural / Mechatronics/Computer Science/ Electronics from a recognized University or equivalent and 3 years' experience OR Masters / Integrated Masters in Mechanical / Agricultural / Mechatronics/Computer Science/ Electronics Engineering or Technology from a recognized University and 2 years' experience. Desirable: Proficiency in mechanical design, CAD/CAE tools, experience in prototype development and engineering, and validation of agricultural machinery OR Programming knowledge in C/C++/Python for Image processing and AI applications in agriculture. Project Associate II: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Technology in Computer Science and Engineering / Electronics and Communication Engineering / Electrical Engineering / Information Technology from a recognized University or equivalent and 2 years’ experience OR Masters / Integrated Masters in Engineering or Technology in Computer Science and Engineering / Electronics and Communication Engineering / Electrical Engineering / Information Technology from a recognized University. Desirable: Programming knowledge in C/C++/Python for Image processing and AI applications in agriculture, Working knowledge of Mechatronics/Robotics system design. Project Associate II: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Technology in Mechanical Engineering/ Agricultural Engineering/ Mechatronics from a recognized University or equivalent and 2 years’ experience OR Masters / Integrated Masters in Engineering or Technology in Mechanical Engineering/ Agricultural Engineering/ Mechatronics from a recognized University. Desirable: Knowledge of CAD software, mechanical Fabrication techniques and design and development of agricultural machinery. Project Associate I: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Technology in Mechanical Engineering / Agriculture Engineering / Mechatronics from a recognized University or equivalent. Desirable: Working knowledge of CAD software, Mechanical Fabrication Techniques, Knowledge of design and development of agriculture machinery. Project Assistant II: 3 years Diploma in Agricultural Engineering / Mechanical Engineering from a recognized University. Project Associate I: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Technology in Mechanical Engineering / Agriculture Engineering / Mechatronics from a recognised University or equivalent. Desirable: Working knowledge of CAD software, Mechanical Fabrication Techniques, Knowledge of design and development of agriculture machinery.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CMERI CoEFM Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced by CSIR CMERI CoEFM?
faq.answer: CSIR CMERI Centre of Excellence for Farm Machinery has announced a total of 7 vacancies for the posts of Senior Project Associate, Project Associate, and Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled to be held on 02 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications range from a 3 years Diploma in Agricultural/Mechanical Engineering to Bachelor's/Master's degrees in Mechanical/Agricultural/Mechatronics/Computer Science/Electronics Engineering.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the candidates?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 40 years, with relaxations applicable as per Government of India/CSIR rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 20,000 to Rs. 42,000 per month, plus HRA for most positions.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the CMERI CoEFM recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at CSIR CMERI Centre of Excellence for Farm Machinery, Ludhiana, Punjab, 141006.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is Contractual.
